investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: A successful MICROSOFT.NETWORK/NETWORKSECURITYGROUPS/WRITE modified a rule on nsg-prod-db-core in the production resource group, adding an inbound TCP 445 rule allowing any source to reach 10.0.1.4. The change was performed by linda.kask@globalcorp.ee from 194.126.101.99 in Tallinn at 12:30 EET, and the user lookup shows a Finance department role (Senior Accountant) which does not align with typical infrastructure administration. Because the modification increases exposure to SMB on a production database subnet, was performed by a business user with a role mismatch, and is an isolated event with no recent correlated deployment activity, this alert is classified as High Priority.
